content: devague converge gate: the rule "a confirmed honesty condition on every spec-affecting claim" covers ALL core frame claims — audience, before_state, after_state, why_it_matters, boundary, success_signal — not just kind=requirement claims. Interrogate + confirm a condition on each, or converge fails with one gap per frame claim. Also: devague auto-adds .devague/reviews/ to .gitignore on first review; frames + specs are committed, review artifacts are working state. (Learned scoping coherence-cli issue #4, 2026-07-04.)
